cancellation_summary: Any changes or cancellations must be made at least 3 days (72 hours) prior to your reservation start date for a full refund.
description: Accommodates up to 4 passengers. The center console design provides a relaxing and stable cruise. The vessel includes rod holders, a live bait well, a bimini shade top, and Bluetooth stereo!
what_is_included: Rentals are for fishing only–fishing licenses & gear required for rental. Don’t have your own gear or license? Our Coronado & Mission Bay locations offer pole rentals and sell frozen bait, tackle, and CA fishing licenses!
what_to_bring: Photo ID for all drivers and credit card used for payment required for check in.
